title: Upgrade Seller Workflow to Use LLM
goal: Replace hardcoded sequential questions in SellerWorkflow with LLM-powered conversational flow.
result_summary: Refactored seller.ts to use LLMService and SystemPromptService.getSellerPrompt(). Still extracts property type via keyword matching for SSOT updates, but generates AI responses via Gemini. Added getSellerPrompt() with context-aware prompting (property_type, location, price status). Seller flow is now multilingual and conversational like BuyerWorkflow.
